source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 20 (PDF 156-168), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 20 (Medical Physics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
Medical Physics: Introduction and Radiations Used

blocks.prompt:
1 Medical physics is the branch of physics that applies physical principles and techniques to:
(Medical physics physics ki woh shaakh hai jo physical usool aur techniques kis cheez par lagati hai?)

options.text: medicine par, khaas taur par bimariyon ki tashkhees aur ilaaj
pulon aur imaraton ke design par
sitaron aur kehkashaon ke mutalay par

blocks.explanation: Medical physics physical usool aur techniques ko medicine par lagati hai, khaas taur par bimariyon ki tashkhees (diagnosis) aur ilaaj mein (introduction).

book_ref.quote: Medical physics is a branch of physics that applies physical principles and techniques to medicine

blocks.prompt:
2 Medical physics plays an important role in modern healthcare mainly by:
(Medical physics jadeed healthcare mein ahem kirdar zyada tar kis tarah ada karti hai?)

options.text: har mareez ko radiation dose barhana
har tashkhees ke liye surgery zaroori banana
imaging ki durusti barhana, radiation ke khatre kam karna aur ilaaj behtar karna

blocks.explanation: Yeh medical imaging ki durusti barhati hai, radiation ke khatre kam karti hai aur ilaaj ke tareeqe behtar karti hai (introduction).

book_ref.quote: by improving the accuracy of medical imaging, reducing radiation risks, and enhancing treatment methods

blocks.prompt:
3 According to the chapter's introduction, positron emission tomography (PET) works through:
(Chapter ke introduction ke mutabiq positron emission tomography (PET) kis cheez se kaam karti hai?)

options.text: radiowaves ka atomic nuclei se interaction

blocks.explanation: PET positron aur electron ki annihilation (fana ho kar energy banna) aur gamma rays ke detection se kaam karti hai (introduction).

book_ref.quote: works through positron–electron annihilation and gamma-ray detection

blocks.prompt:
4 Techniques such as X-ray imaging, ultrasound, CT and PET allow doctors to study internal organs:
(X-ray imaging, ultrasound, CT aur PET jaisi techniques doctors ko andarooni aaza (organs) ka mutala kis tarah karne deti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh techniques doctors ko haddi ke toot (fracture) dhoondne, tumor ki tashkhees aur andarooni aaza ka mutala surgery ke baghair karne deti hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: These techniques allow doctors to detect fractures, diagnose tumors, and to study internal organs without surgery.

blocks.prompt:
5 Radiation is the transfer of energy through space or matter in the form of:
(Radiation khala (space) ya maadde (matter) mein energy ki muntaqili kis shakal mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radiation khala ya maadde mein waves ya particles ki shakal mein energy ki muntaqili hai (introduction).

book_ref.quote: Radiation is the transfer of energy through space or matter in the form of waves or particles.

blocks.prompt:
6 Ionizing radiation is radiation that has enough energy to:
(Ionizing radiation woh hai jis mein itni energy ho ke woh:)

options.text: atoms se electrons nikaal kar ions banaye
sirf tissue ki sarhadon se reflect ho

blocks.explanation: Ionizing radiation itni energy rakhti hai ke atoms se electrons nikaal de aur ions (barqi zarraat) banaye; non-ionizing nahin (introduction).

book_ref.quote: Ionizing radiation has enough energy to remove electrons from atoms, producing ions.

blocks.prompt:
7 Which of the following is a non-ionizing radiation used in medical physics?
(In mein se kaun si non-ionizing radiation medical physics mein istemaal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ultrasound waves aur radiowaves non-ionizing hain; X-rays, gamma rays aur positrons ionizing misalein hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: examples of non-ionizing radiations are ultrasound waves and radiowaves

blocks.prompt:
8 X-rays and gamma rays interact with matter through:
(X-rays aur gamma rays maadde se kis tarah interact karti hain?)

options.text: photoelectric effect aur Compton scattering se

blocks.explanation: X-rays aur gamma rays ka maadde se interaction photoelectric effect aur Compton scattering se hota hai (introduction).

book_ref.quote: Interaction of X-rays and gamma rays with matter occurs through photoelectric effect and Compton scattering.

blocks.prompt:
9 In medical physics, the positrons used for imaging are emitted from:
(Medical physics mein imaging ke liye positrons kahan se kharij hote hain?)

options.text: X-ray tube ke garam filament se

blocks.explanation: Positrons radioactive tracers se kharij hote hain (introduction; PET mein istemaal, 20.5).

book_ref.quote: The positrons are emitted from radioactive tracers.

blocks.prompt:
10 When non-ionizing waves such as ultrasound and radiowaves interact with matter, they are:
(Jab ultrasound aur radiowaves jaisi non-ionizing waves maadde se interact karti hain to woh:)

options.text: reflect, refract ya absorb hoti hain
hamesha atoms ko ionize karti hain

blocks.explanation: Non-ionizing waves maadde se milne par reflect, refract ya absorb hoti hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: These waves are reflected, refracted, or absorbed when these interact with the matter.

blocks.prompt:
11 Gamma rays are used in nuclear medicine, such as PET scans and cancer treatment, because of their:
(Gamma rays nuclear medicine (PET scans aur cancer ke ilaaj) mein kis wajah se istemaal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gamma rays apni zyada guzarne ki salahiyat (penetrating power) ki wajah se nuclear medicine aur cancer ke ilaaj mein istemaal hoti hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: due to their high penetrating power

blocks.prompt:
12 Radiowaves are used in medical imaging in the technique of:
(Medical imaging mein radiowaves kis technique mein istemaal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Radiowaves MRI mein istemaal hoti hain jahan woh atomic nuclei se interact kar ke naram tissues ki tasweer banati hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: Radiowaves are used in techniques such as MRI

blocks.prompt:
13 In MRI, radiowaves help produce detailed images by interacting with:
(MRI mein radiowaves kis cheez se interact kar ke tafseeli tasaveer banane mein madad karti hain?)

options.text: tungsten ke andarooni shell electrons se

blocks.explanation: MRI mein radiowaves atomic nuclei (atom ke markaz) se interact kar ke tafseeli tasaveer banati hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: by interacting with atomic nuclei

blocks.prompt:
14 The dual role of an ultrasound transducer is that it:
(Ultrasound transducer ka dohra (dual) kirdar kya hai?)

options.text: X-rays paida karta aur gamma rays detect karta hai
tissue ko garam kar ke temperature napta hai
tracer daal kar positrons detect karta hai
ultrasound waves paida karta hai aur reflected signals detect karta hai

blocks.explanation: Transducer ultrasound waves paida bhi karta hai aur jism ke andar se wapas aane wale signals detect bhi karta hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: The transducer plays a dual role; it generates ultrasound waves and detects the reflected signals from inside the body.

blocks.prompt:
15 Ultrasound imaging is described in the chapter as a technique that is:
(Chapter mein ultrasound imaging ko kis qisam ki technique kaha gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ultrasound aam istemaal hone wali non-invasive (jism mein kuch daale baghair) technique hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Ultrasound is a widely used, non-invasive medical imaging technique

blocks.prompt:
16 The Greek word "piezein", from which "piezoelectric" is formed, means:
(Yunani lafz "piezein", jis se "piezoelectric" bana, ka matlab hai:)
blocks.explanation: "Piezein" ka matlab "dabana" hai; "electric" bijli paida hone ko kehte hain (20.1).

book_ref.quote: comes from the Greek word "piezein," which means "to press"

blocks.prompt:
17 The piezoelectric effect was discovered in 1880 by:
(Piezoelectric effect 1880 mein kis ne daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh 1880 mein do French scientists, Pierre Curie aur Jacques Curie ne daryaft kiya (20.1).

book_ref.quote: This effect was discovered in 1880 by two French scientists, Pierre Curie and Jacques Curie.

blocks.prompt:
18 Which set of crystals did the Curie brothers experiment with?
(Curie bhaiyon ne kin crystals par tajurbat kiye?)
blocks.explanation: Unhon ne quartz, tourmaline aur Rochelle salt par tajurbat kiye (20.1).

book_ref.quote: They were experimenting with crystals such as quartz, tourmaline, and Rochelle salt

blocks.prompt:
19 Rochelle salt, one of the piezoelectric crystals, is chemically:
(Rochelle salt, jo aik piezoelectric crystal hai, kimiyaai taur par kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Rochelle salt sodium potassium tartrate hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Rochelle salt (sodium potassium tartrate)

blocks.prompt:
20 The piezoelectric material PZT, shown in the chapter's figure of the effect, is:
(Chapter ki figure mein dikhaya gaya piezoelectric material PZT kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: PZT lead zirconate titanate hai (Fig. 20.1, book correction ke mutabiq) (20.1).

book_ref.quote: the material is lead zirconate titanate (PZT)

blocks.prompt:
21 The piezoelectric effect occurs in crystals that:
(Piezoelectric effect kin crystals mein hota hai?)

options.text: jin ka centre of symmetry nahin hota
jin ka mukammal centre of symmetry ho
jo metals ki tarah bijli guzarein
jin mein koi charge na ho

blocks.explanation: Piezoelectric crystals mein markaz-e-tanasub (centre of symmetry) nahin hota aur un mein positive aur negative charge ke chhote hisse hote hain (20.1).

book_ref.quote: These crystals have no centre of symmetry

blocks.prompt:
22 In a piezoelectric crystal, an electric field appears on the surface when pressure is applied because:
(Piezoelectric crystal par dabao dalne se surface par electric field kyun paida hoti hai?)

options.text: positive aur negative charges ka tawazun bigarta hai aur charges thora hilte hain

blocks.explanation: Aam taur par charges barabar hote hain; dabao se yeh tawazun bigarta hai, charges thora hilte hain aur surface par field aati hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Normally, these charges are balanced, but when pressure is applied, the balance is disturbed

blocks.prompt:
23 Production of an electric field on the surface of a crystal when mechanical pressure is applied is called the:
(Crystal par mechanical dabao se us ki surface par electric field paida hona kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dabao se electric field paida hona direct piezoelectric effect hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: This is called the direct piezoelectric effect.

blocks.prompt:
24 When an electric field is applied to a piezoelectric crystal, it changes shape a little. This is the:
(Piezoelectric crystal par electric field lagane se us ki shakal thori badal jati hai. Yeh kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electric field se shakal ki tabdeeli converse (ulta) piezoelectric effect hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: This is called the converse piezoelectric effect.

blocks.prompt:
25 The piezoelectric effect makes it possible to turn:
(Piezoelectric effect kis cheez ko kis mein badalna mumkin banata hai?)

options.text: dabao ko voltage mein aur voltage ko dabao mein

blocks.explanation: Yeh dabao ko voltage mein aur voltage ko dabao mein badalta hai; isi tarah ultrasound jism se "baat" karta hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: The piezoelectric effect makes it possible to turn pressure into voltage and vice versa.

blocks.text: 20.2 Diagnostic Use of Ultrasound in Medical Imaging

blocks.prompt:
26 The ultrasound waves sent into the body for imaging typically have frequencies in the range:
(Imaging ke liye jism mein bheji jane wali ultrasound waves ki frequency aam taur par kis range mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ultrasound imaging oonchi frequency ki awaaz ki waves istemaal karti hai, aam taur par 1 MHz-15 MHz (20.2).

book_ref.quote: typically in the range of 1 MHz-15 MHz

blocks.prompt:
27 A key advantage of ultrasound imaging is that it is safe and repeatable because:
(Ultrasound imaging ka aik ahem faida yeh hai ke yeh mehfooz aur dobara kiya ja sakta hai, kyunke:)

options.text: yeh bohat zyada energy wali X-rays istemaal karta hai
yeh ionizing radiation istemaal nahin karta
yeh gamma rays istemaal karta hai

blocks.explanation: Ultrasound ionizing radiation istemaal nahin karta, is liye mehfooz, non-invasive aur dobara qabil-e-istemaal hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: it does not use ionizing radiation and making it a safe, non-invasive, and repeatable imaging method

blocks.prompt:
28 Part of an ultrasound wave is reflected when it meets a boundary between two tissues that have different:
(Ultrasound wave ka kuch hissa tab reflect hota hai jab woh do aise tissues ki sarhad par pahunche jin ki kya mukhtalif ho?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif acoustic impedance (awaaz ki mazahmat) wale tissues ki sarhad par wave ka kuch hissa reflect hota hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: When these waves encounter a boundary between two tissues with different acoustic impedances

blocks.prompt:
29 The acoustic impedance of a tissue is determined by:
(Kisi tissue ki acoustic impedance kis cheez se tay hoti hai?)

options.text: tissue ki density aur us mein awaaz ki raftaar

blocks.explanation: Acoustic impedance tissue ki density (kasafat) aur us mein awaaz ki raftaar se tay hoti hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: (determined by tissue density and sound speed)

blocks.prompt:
30 In receive mode, the ultrasound transducer detects the reflected waves using the:
(Receive mode mein ultrasound transducer reflected waves ko kis effect se detect karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transducer receive mode mein ja kar reflected waves ko direct piezoelectric effect se detect karta hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: detects these reflected waves using the direct piezoelectric effect

blocks.prompt:
31 To construct an ultrasound image, the computer uses the returning echoes':
(Ultrasound image banane ke liye computer wapas aane wale echoes ki kaun si cheezen istemaal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Computer wapas aane wale echoes ki der (time delay) aur shiddat (intensity) se image banata hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: a computer calculates the time delay and intensity of the returning echoes

blocks.prompt:
32 In an ultrasound image, areas that produce stronger reflections appear:
(Ultrasound image mein zyada taaqatwar reflection wale hisse kaise nazar aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada taaqatwar reflection wale hisse zyada roshan nazar aate hain (20.2).

book_ref.quote: Areas with stronger reflections appear brighter in the image

blocks.prompt:
33 The ultrasound pulses emitted by the transducer travel through the body:
(Transducer se nikalne wali ultrasound pulses jism mein kis tarah safar karti hain?)

options.text: har tissue mein roshni ki raftaar se
har tissue mein bilkul aik hi raftaar se
tissue ki qisam ke mutabiq mukhtalif raftaar se

blocks.explanation: Pulses tissue ki qisam ke mutabiq mukhtalif raftaar se chalti hain (20.2).

book_ref.quote: which travel at different speeds depending on the type of tissue they pass through

blocks.prompt:
34 According to the chapter, the crystals in an ultrasound probe are:
(Chapter ke mutabiq ultrasound probe ke crystals:)

options.text: sirf awaaz bhej sakte hain, detect nahin
chawal ke daane se chhote, phir bhi awaaz bhejte aur detect karte hain

blocks.explanation: Probe ke crystals chawal ke daane se chhote hain magar awaaz bhejte bhi hain aur detect bhi karte hain (20.2).

book_ref.quote: The crystals in an ultrasound probe are smaller than a grain of rice

blocks.prompt:
35 An ultrasound probe works at 5.0 MHz in soft tissue where the speed of sound is 1540 m s⁻¹. Using v = fλ, the wavelength of the waves in the tissue is:
(Ultrasound probe 5.0 MHz par naram tissue mein kaam karta hai jahan awaaz ki raftaar 1540 m s⁻¹ hai. v = fλ se tissue mein wavelength kya hogi?)

book_ref.quote: It operates by sending high frequency sound waves

blocks.prompt:
36 An echo from an organ boundary returns to the transducer 104 μs after the pulse is sent. If sound travels at 1540 m s⁻¹ in the tissue, the depth of the boundary is about:
(Organ ki sarhad se echo pulse bhejne ke 104 μs baad transducer par wapas aata hai. Agar tissue mein awaaz 1540 m s⁻¹ se chale to sarhad ki gehrai taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pulse ja kar wapas aati hai, is liye gehrai = vt/2 = 1540 × 104 × 10⁻⁶ / 2 = 0.080 m = 8.0 cm (20.2).

book_ref.quote: The reflected echoes are then collected and analyzed to create an image.

blocks.prompt:
37 In obstetrics, ultrasound is used to:
(Obstetrics (zachgi ke shoba) mein ultrasound kis kaam aata hai?)

options.text: fetus ki nashonuma dekhna aur gestational age ka andaza
X-rays se haddi ki density naapna

blocks.explanation: Obstetrics mein yeh bachche (fetus) ki nashonuma dekhta, hamal ki umar (gestational age) ka andaza lagata aur kharabiyan pehchanta hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: it helps monitor fetal growth, estimate gestational age

blocks.prompt:
38 Echocardiography, an ultrasound technique, is used in cardiology to evaluate:
(Echocardiography, jo aik ultrasound technique hai, cardiology mein kis cheez ko jaanchti hai?)

options.text: dimagh mein tracer ka jama hona
dil ki banawat aur kaam, real time mein

blocks.explanation: Echocardiography se doctors dil ki banawat aur kaam ko foran (real time) jaanchte hain (20.2).

book_ref.quote: In cardiology, echo cardiography allows doctors to evaluate

blocks.prompt:
39 Which group of organs is examined by ultrasound in the abdominal region?
(Pet (abdominal) ke hisse mein ultrasound se kaun se aaza dekhe jate hain?)

options.text: Liver, kidneys, gallbladder, pancreas aur bladder
Sirf khopri, reerh ki haddi aur pasliyan

blocks.explanation: Pet ke hisse mein ultrasound liver, kidneys, gallbladder, pancreas aur bladder dekhta hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: such as the liver, kidneys, gallbladder, pancreas, and bladder

blocks.prompt:
40 In the musculoskeletal system, ultrasound aids in detecting:
(Musculoskeletal system (patthe aur haddiyan) mein ultrasound kis cheez ka pata lagane mein madad karta hai?)

options.text: ligament ki chot aur joron ki sozish

blocks.explanation: Musculoskeletal system mein yeh ligament ki chot, joron ki sozish (inflammation) aur doosre naram tissue ke masail dhoondta hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: it aids in detecting ligament injuries, joint inflammation

blocks.prompt:
41 In urology, ultrasound is used to examine:
(Urology mein ultrasound se kya dekha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Urology mein ultrasound se prostate, testicles aur peshab ka nizam (urinary system) dekha jata hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: The field of urology also benefits from ultrasound

blocks.prompt:
42 Stronger echoes and clearer boundaries in an ultrasound image are produced when the two tissues have:
(Ultrasound image mein zyada taaqatwar echoes aur saaf sarhaden tab banti hain jab do tissues mein:)

options.text: acoustic impedance ka zyada farq ho
un ke darmiyan gel na ho

blocks.explanation: Acoustic impedance ka zyada farq (maslan naram tissue aur haddi) zyada taaqatwar echoes aur saaf sarhaden deta hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: A higher difference between two tissues (e.g., soft tissue and bone) causes stronger echoes

blocks.prompt:
43 Compared with low frequency ultrasound, high frequency ultrasound gives:
(Kam frequency ke muqable mein zyada frequency wala ultrasound kya deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada frequency behtar wazahat (resolution) magar kam gehrai tak pahunch deti hai; kam frequency gehra jati hai magar tasweer kam saaf hoti hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: Higher frequency ultrasound offers better resolution but less penetration

blocks.prompt:
44 To image an organ lying deep inside the body, the better choice is ultrasound of:
(Jism ke andar gehrai mein maujood organ ki tasweer ke liye behtar intikhab kaun sa ultrasound hai?)

options.text: kam frequency, kam saaf tasweer qubool kar ke
koi bhi frequency, gehrai se farq nahin parta

blocks.explanation: Kam frequency ki waves zyada gehrai tak jati hain, agarche tasweer kam saaf hoti hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: lower frequency waves penetrate deeper but have lower image clarity

blocks.prompt:
45 A special gel is applied between the ultrasound transducer and the skin in order to:
(Ultrasound transducer aur jild ke darmiyan khaas gel kyun lagai jati hai?)

options.text: hawa ke khala khatam aur awaaz ki muntaqili behtar karna

blocks.explanation: Gel hawa ke khala (air gaps) khatam karti hai aur awaaz ki waves ki muntaqili behtar karti hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: to remove air gaps and improve sound waves transmission

blocks.prompt:
46 Ultrasound can measure the speed of blood flow by detecting shifts in sound frequency. This uses the:
(Ultrasound awaaz ki frequency mein tabdeeli pakar kar khoon ke bahao ki raftaar naap sakta hai. Is mein kaun sa effect istemaal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ultrasound Doppler effect se, frequency ki tabdeeli pakar kar, khoon ke bahao ki raftaar naapta hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: measure blood flow speed using the Doppler effect

blocks.prompt:
47 Taking the speed of sound in tissue as 1540 m s⁻¹ and v = fλ, the wavelength of 12 MHz ultrasound is:
(Tissue mein awaaz ki raftaar 1540 m s⁻¹ aur v = fλ le kar 12 MHz ultrasound ki wavelength kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: λ = v/f = 1540 / (12 × 10⁶) = 1.28 × 10⁻⁴ m = 0.128 mm. Zyada frequency ki chhoti wavelength behtar resolution deti hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: Frequency of Ultrasound: Higher frequency ultrasound

blocks.prompt:
48 Transitions of electrons in hydrogen or other light elements give spectral lines in the:
(Hydrogen ya doosre halke elements mein electrons ki transitions kis region mein spectral lines deti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Halke elements mein energy ke chhote farq infrared, visible ya ultraviolet region mein lines dete hain (20.3).

book_ref.quote: result in the emission of spectral lines in the infrared, visible or ultraviolet region

blocks.prompt:
49 In a heavy atom, the electron shell closest to the nucleus is the:
(Bhaari atom mein nucleus ke sab se qareeb kaun sa shell hai?)
blocks.explanation: Shells K, L, M, N, O, ... hain; K-shell nucleus ke sab se qareeb hai (20.3).

book_ref.quote: The K-shell being closest to the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
50 Transitions of inner-shell electrons in heavy atoms give X-rays rather than visible light because the inner electrons are:
(Bhaari atoms mein andarooni shell electrons ki transitions visible light ke bajaye X-rays kyun deti hain? Kyunke andarooni electrons:)

options.text: dheele bandhe hain, is liye energy ke farq chhote hain
mazbooti se bandhe hain, is liye energy ke farq bare hain

blocks.explanation: Andarooni electrons mazbooti se bandhe hote hain, unhein hatane ke liye zyada energy chahiye; wapsi par zyada energy ke photons (X-rays) nikalte hain (20.3).

book_ref.quote: The inner shell electrons are tightly bound

blocks.prompt:
51 The X-rays from inner-shell transitions are called characteristic X-rays because they:
(Andarooni shell transitions se nikalne wali X-rays ko characteristic X-rays kyun kehte hain? Kyunke woh:)

options.text: makhsoos wavelengths ya frequencies ki series hain
sirf hydrogen atom se aati hain

blocks.explanation: Yeh makhsoos wavelengths ya frequencies ki series par mushtamil hoti hain, is liye characteristic X-rays kehlati hain (20.3).

book_ref.quote: These X-rays consist of series of specific wavelengths or frequencies

blocks.prompt:
52 The study of characteristic X-ray spectra has played an important role in the study of:
(Characteristic X-ray spectra ke mutale ne kis cheez ke mutale mein ahem kirdar ada kiya?)

options.text: atom ki banawat aur periodic table

blocks.explanation: Characteristic X-ray spectra ne atom ki banawat aur periodic table ke mutale mein madad di (20.3).

book_ref.quote: has played a very important role in the study of atomic structure and the periodic table

blocks.prompt:
53 A transition in a light atom releases a photon of energy 1.9 eV. Taking h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ and 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, its wavelength is about:
(Halke atom mein aik transition 1.9 eV energy ka photon deti hai. h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ aur 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J le kar is ki wavelength taqreeban kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: due to small energy differences in the transition levels

blocks.prompt:
54 An inner-shell transition in a heavy atom emits a photon of energy 8.0 keV. With h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ and 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, its wavelength is:
(Bhaari atom mein andarooni shell ki transition 8.0 keV ka photon deti hai. h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ aur 1 eV = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ J le kar is ki wavelength kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: photons of larger energy are emitted

blocks.prompt:
55 X-rays are produced in an X-ray tube, which is a:
(X-rays X-ray tube mein banti hain, jo aik:)
blocks.explanation: Yeh intizam aik high vacuum (hawa se khali) tube par mushtamil hai jise X-ray tube kehte hain (20.3).

book_ref.quote: It consists of a high vacuum tube called X-ray tube.

blocks.prompt:
56 In an X-ray tube, electrons are emitted by the:
(X-ray tube mein electrons kahan se kharij hote hain?)

options.text: filament se garam kiye gaye cathode se

blocks.explanation: Filament F se garam kiya gaya cathode electrons kharij karta hai jo anode T ki taraf tez kiye jate hain (20.3).

book_ref.quote: When the cathode is heated by the filament F.

blocks.prompt:
57 If V is the potential difference between cathode and target, the maximum kinetic energy with which an electron (charge e) strikes the target is:
(Agar cathode aur target ke darmiyan potential difference V ho to electron (charge e) target se zyada se zyada kis kinetic energy se takrata hai?)

book_ref.quote: the (K.E.)ₘₐₓ with which the electron strikes the target is given by

blocks.prompt:
58 The target in an X-ray tube is made of:
(X-ray tube ka target kis cheez ka hota hai?)

options.text: tungsten ya koi aur bhaari element

blocks.explanation: Tez electrons tungsten ya kisi aur bhaari element ke target se takrate hain (20.3).

book_ref.quote: strike a target made of tungsten or any other heavy element

blocks.prompt:
59 Electrons in an X-ray tube are accelerated through 30 kV. Taking e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, the maximum kinetic energy with which they strike the target is:
